name: cryoshield-payload-v2
encoding: hex: lowercase hex of the exact payload bytes. text: the same bytes as a string when they are well-formed UTF-8, else null. decoded: {version, name|null, archived, items:[{l,s}], pad|null}. canonicalHex: what a writer emits for the decoded value (equal to hex for positive vectors, except v1-legacy-* ones, which the deployed v1 rules accept although not canonical; for negative vectors that parse and validate but differ byte-wise, what the re-encoding produced, else null). Some strings hold escaped unpaired surrogates: parse with JSON.parse or Python json. Blob vectors use credentials A and B of packages/vault-crypto/test-vectors/v1.json.

constants.unknownVersionRule: v is a JSON number other than 1 or 2 (after JSON.parse)

A pretty-printed (legacy) v1 vault: sized from its actual byte length.
Previous length is C0 + 8: z is a single 0.
Tiny v1 vault, C0 < previous < C0 + 8: z of one 0 fits in the previous block, so the payload is slightly longer and the blob length is unchanged.
An unarchived cleared vault with z of one 0: C0 >= previous, no z.
An unarchived cleared vault with z of two 0s: C0 == previous, no z.
Previous payload fills its 64-byte block (62 bytes), C0 = 56: z of one 0 (64 bytes) would grow the blob by a block (the rule before review L1), so no z.
Same payload in a vault whose capacity is 62 bytes: no z, the blob length is unchanged.
